Chernobog - Operation Squad E0's Location
Dr. {@nickname} Rescue Operation, Phase 3

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Ah!

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: This clinic...

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Amiya, haven't we been here before?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You're right...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But why has it... become like this?

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: It's been totally abandoned... It looks it was attacked by Reunion.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Wasn't this Azazel, the clinic for the Infected?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Even though they had access to Chernobog's entire underground intelligence network, they still refused to work with us...

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Back then, it wasn't clear what kind of dealings that had with Reunion...

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: If only they had given us some information, or even just a hint...

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: We could've been out of here by now.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: They brought this outcome upon themselves!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's not the entire story...

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Amiya, you were there for the negotiations, weren't you?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: That cold and arrogant attitude of theirs really ticked me off...

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: We can't blame them.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Boss...

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: It's hard for the Infected to trust anyone.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: After enduring so many hardships, who can blame them for becoming jaded and stubborn?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can understand why they did what they did... and I can forgive them. Those who don't protect themselves are easily hurt by others.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Moreover, the Infected often can't even trust each other. Not everyone is able to stomach the kinds of risks that we take either...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Azazel... They were a black-market clinic that only provided services to the Infected.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Given the social status of the Infected, they couldn't openly reveal themselves in public.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Some of the Infected, not wanting to be thrown into quarantine, are hiding throughout the city, just trying to survive.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Azazel was aimed at providing services to these people.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...They must have rejected Reunion's proposals.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, I previously mentioned that we're all sick, right?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This disease will claim our lives, but it also grants us with extraordinary powers.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: For example, I can use Originium Arts without the aid of a staff.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: However, this disease does not only destroy our bodies...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It also destroys any chance we have at living a normal life. Or rather, 'civilized society' strips everything away from us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Chernobog has been the shining beacon of this 'civility.'

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Fearing, hating, exiling, and purging the Infected...

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: And, this is how it ends.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The only thing is, how many Infected were even given the option to choose between us, Reunion, or some other organization?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Most of them simply lost everything.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Perhaps, this clinic was a warm place that some of them could call home...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There is no cure for Oripathy. At least right now, the Infected can only die in despair.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And their bodies... become new sources of infection.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: With their abnormal powers and fatally infectious disease...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Infected... are the most hated people on this planet.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, you probably won't be able to understand everything just based upon my brief explanation.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But when you see the consequences of these problems with your own eyes... you will understand.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You'll see the harsh reality surrounding the Infected.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Rhodes Island emphasizes equality for all, whereas Reunion is fanatically Infected-centric. However, organizations like ours are a rare sight.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I can understand why you're angry, but it's hard not to sympathize with this little clinic.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: ...I see.

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Perhaps they really ended up facing a bigger crisis than they could handle...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: In any case, we should leave our anger behind, along with this clinic.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island is filled with good people. Though fear and hostility might create rifts between people...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I believe that all misunderstandings will be resolved, as long as we're a part of the same family.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Perhaps... Rhodes Island is but another Azazel?

steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Amiya...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Let's go, Doctor.
